versions.changelog:
Initial release: drawio-to-html 1.0.0

- Converts drawio/diagrams.net (.drawio) files to standalone HTML with embedded SVG for browser viewing or sharing.
- Supports native drawio XML format, extracting node shapes, arrows, labels, and standard flowchart features.
- No external dependencies; outputs a self-contained HTML file.
- Provides user feedback on output location, size, diagram name, and any render limitations.
- Known limitations: does not support swimlanes, images, or custom shapes; renders only the first diagram per file.
